def vpass(g,mode='up_then_down'):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out={}
    for c in range(W):
        nz=[(r,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) if g[r][c]]
        if not nz: continue
        n=N=nz[-1][0]
        # upward from bottom of run? Actually fill above a run's start with the run's own color (like demo2 col3 rows4-8 = 4, run starts row8)
        for rr in range(n,0,-1):
            if (rr,c) in out or g[rr][c]: break
            out[(rr,c)]=nz[0][2]  # own run color upward
        m=mz=nz[0][0]
        for rr in range(m,H):
            if (rr,c) in out or g[rr][c]: break
            out[(rr,c)]=nz[-1][2]  # downward below run
    return out
